title: micrandra sprucei
intro: Micrandra sprucei, commonly known as West Indian almond, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to alleviate conditions such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Micrandra sprucei include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral effects. Additionally, its therapeutic actions include treating skin conditions like eczema and promoting wound healing, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine.
